name: Halls of the Void Savant
prompt_style: Objects are modeled 3D assets from a modern dark-fantasy dungeon-crawler video game (Unreal Engine 5), seen from above, sized correctly for the room, each casting a soft dark contact shadow onto the floor. Sand-blown, ancient desert ruin: dust and drifted sand on objects, faded indigo and silver star-and-moon motifs on stone and cloth.

1.name: Hall of Arrival
1.art: an entry crossroads: two toppled sandstone lion statues, a cracked stone water trough, drifts of sand against the walls, scorpion husks.

2.name: Moon Pool
2.art: a shrine around a still dark pool (already drawn at the west side; leave it exactly as it is): a large circular floor mosaic of a crescent moon and stars in indigo and silver tiles in the dry part of the room, two low stone benches, a few broken offering bowls.

3.name: Broken Study
3.art: a ruined study: smashed wooden furniture (a broken desk, splintered chairs, a collapsed cabinet) in heaps, a few glinting gems visible under the wreckage, torn star charts on the floor.

4.name: Hearth of Leaving
4.art: a hall with a large carved stone fireplace against the south wall burning with a cold violet-white magical flame, a worn rug in front of it, two stone armchairs, a fallen candelabra.

5.name: Nest Gallery
5.art: a gallery overrun by giant scorpions: piles of sand and rubble, cracked display plinths, broken pottery, scattered bones and shed scorpion carapaces.

6.name: Star Rotunda
6.art: a small round chamber: an orrery-like brass armillary sphere on a stone base in the exact center, star patterns inlaid in the floor ring, sand drifts at the edges.

7.name: Hall of Lenses
7.art: a great hall: three large tarnished brass telescopes on stone mounts aimed at the ceiling, a long cracked worktable with lenses and tools, collapsed bookshelves, sand drifts, scorpion husks.

8.name: Long Observatory
8.art: a long gallery: a row of stone pedestals holding crystal lenses and broken astrolabes, faded star maps on the floor, sand drifts.

9.name: Sellsword's End
9.art: a small round chamber: a dead human sellsword in chain mail lying on his back with a broken sword, a dropped shield, his pack spilled, three dead scorpions around him.

10.name: Brood Hall
10.art: a scorpion brood chamber: large mounds of sand with burrow holes, clutches of pale scorpion eggs, broken stone columns lying in pieces, bones.

11.name: Ogre Den
11.art: an ogre camp in a large ruined hall: a big fire pit with charred bones and a spit, crude hide bedrolls, piles of looted junk and broken furniture, a huge wooden club leaning on a pillar stump, gnawed bones everywhere.

12.name: Sand Stair Hall
12.art: a hall half buried in drifted sand flowing down from the west, broken stone urns, a fallen bronze gong, scorpion husks.

13.name: Crumbling Antechamber
13.art: a small antechamber: cracked floor slabs with sand pouring through the cracks in the center, a toppled statue of a robed scholar, scattered rubble.

14.name: Rotten Store
14.art: an old storeroom: rotten wooden shelves, burst sacks of grain and spilled sand, broken jars, one rotten iron-bound wooden chest in the middle with its lid ajar.

15.name: Armory Alcove
15.art: a small armory: an old tall wooden locker against the north wall with its door hanging open, empty weapon racks, a broken shield, a dented helmet.

16.name: Ironclad Door
16.art: a vestibule: the east wall holds a round ironclad double door with a large keyhole (the doorway on the east wall; keep it clear), two stone guardian statues flanking it, sand drifts.

17.name: Hall of the Safe
17.art: a columned vault (the round stone columns are already drawn; leave them exactly): a heavy mechanical brass-and-iron safe with gears and dials against the east end, frost spreading across the floor around it, toppled brass instruments.

18.name: Ogre Larder
18.art: an ogre larder: hanging carcasses on hooks, a stained butcher's block, barrels, piles of bones and a heap of rusted weapons.

19.name: Void-Scarred Hall
19.art: a hall scarred by void magic: the floor cracked in a radiating pattern of black glassy fissures, floating rubble frozen in place, toppled scholar statues, dead scorpions blackened and crystallized.

20.name: Shaman's Rest
20.art: a long chamber: the remains of a tribal shaman in feathered robes slumped against the north wall with gold coins clutched in his bony hands, a broken staff, a scattered ritual circle of stones, huge ogre footprints and a dropped ogre club.

21.name: Hall of the Void
21.art: a ritual hall: a large circle of black glass inlaid in the floor with silver star symbols, four broken obsidian pillars around it, drifts of black sand, crystallized scorpion husks.

22.name: Savant's Sanctum
22.art: the inner sanctum: a stone throne-like reading chair with a long-dead robed skeleton slumped in it, a stone desk heaped with star charts, a rift-like crack of black void glass in the floor behind it, a nest of crystallized black sand around it.
